caption:
One woman against an entire marble quarry.
Seedance 2.5 choreographed every single hit.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Look: ultra-photorealistic live-action martial arts film, Hollywood action cinematography, wide anamorphic lens, natural flat overcast daylight, desaturated cool-grey grade where the only strong colors are the black of the heroine and the dark oxblood red of her enemies, white marble dust in the air, subtle motion blur. Camera feel: low, fast, handheld-dynamic tracking at knee height, quick whip pans, brief slow-motion on the big impacts, and a final high aerial drone move. Pacing: frantic, many very short cuts (0.3-1 second) in the first 10 seconds, then one long aerial crane-down, a hero landing and a wide aerial finale. No on-screen text, no logos, no subtitles.

CHARACTERS:
- THE HEROINE: East Asian woman in her early 20s, fair porcelain skin, dark smoky eyes, defined brows, dark berry-red lips, calm fierce expression with a slight confident smirk. Long glossy black hair pulled into a very high ponytail with thin braids along the top of her head; the ponytail whips through the air with every move. Wears a fitted black sleeveless corset vest with a deep V neckline and a criss-cross lace-up back, sheer black mesh long sleeves, black leather fingerless gauntlet gloves, black belts with small silver buckles, a short black skirt with a long flowing black chiffon over-layer that trails behind her like a coat tail, and black thigh-high leather boots. Signature: the high braided ponytail and the long black trailing chiffon panel that flares on every spin.
- THE ENEMIES: about thirty big muscular men, most with shaved heads, many with short dark beards, all in identical worn dark oxblood-red work coveralls and black combat boots, carrying sledgehammers, pickaxes and short iron bars.
- THE BRUTE: one huge bald man with a bushy black beard, bare muscular chest crossed by black leather harness straps, heavy black leather shoulder armor and spiked black leather bracers, dark red trousers.

LOCATION: a vast open-pit white marble quarry under a white-grey overcast sky: sheer terraced walls of cut white and cream marble with orange-tan rust stains near the top, green wooded hills beyond the rim, a flat floor of white marble covered in thin dark hairline cracks and white dust, large rectangular cut marble blocks and broken boulders scattered around, and a black lattice-boom crawler crane standing at the back left.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.5) — The charge. Low wide tracking shot at knee height moving through the quarry floor: a dozen men in red coveralls rush in from all sides with hammers raised; the heroine runs between them toward camera, black chiffon flying behind her, a tall marble block behind her; she spins and drives a high kick into a man's chest and he flies backward off his feet, marble dust bursting from the ground.
SHOT 2 (00:01.5-00:01.9) — The glance. Medium close-up, camera low and close: she glances back over her shoulder at the lens with a sly smirk while a man at frame left swings a sledgehammer at her; a white boulder behind her.
SHOT 3 (00:01.9-00:02.15) — The whip. Medium close-up from the front, fast whip pan: she twists hard, her ponytail whipping in a long arc, red-clad men blurred around her.
SHOT 4 (00:02.15-00:02.95) — From behind. Medium shot from behind her: the criss-cross laced back of her vest, she punches a red-suited man in the gut, her chiffon skirt flaring across the bottom of frame, men charging in the background.
SHOT 5 (00:02.95-00:03.95) — The sweep. Low wide side angle at ground level: a man raises a pickaxe overhead; she drops low and spins in a full leg sweep, her black chiffon fanning flat, then springs up into a flying spin kick as a cloud of white marble dust explodes off the ground.
SHOT 6 (00:03.95-00:04.4) — Running boots. Ground-level tracking close shot racing alongside her black thigh-high boots and fluttering chiffon as she sprints, men charging in soft focus behind.
SHOT 7 (00:04.4-00:04.9) — The crash. Extreme low angle at floor level: a red-suited man slams into the ground beside a white marble boulder, his boot skidding past the lens in a puff of dust.
SHOT 8 (00:04.9-00:05.4) — The brute. Wide shot: the bearded brute in black leather shoulder armor lunges with a huge punch; she plants her feet and catches it on her forearm.
SHOT 9 (00:05.4-00:05.9) — Grip. Medium close-up side view: she grips the brute's thick wrist and twists it, his face snarling inches from hers, her ponytail flying behind her.
SHOT 10 (00:05.9-00:06.25) — Side kick. Medium wide, low angle: she fires a high side kick that sends a red-suited man flying backward; another man with a sledgehammer at frame left; a beaten man lies across the foreground.
SHOT 11 (00:06.25-00:06.55) — Over the shoulder. Low angle from behind a red-suited man as he swings a long-handled hammer down toward her; she stands calmly in the distance, cracks splitting across the marble floor between them.
SHOT 12 (00:06.55-00:07.3) — The leap. Low angle looking up: she vaults onto the top of a tall rectangular white marble block and crouches there mid-leap, chiffon spread out like wings against the grey sky, men falling below.
SHOT 13 (00:07.3-00:07.8) — Dust wipe. The camera passes through a thick dark cloud of marble dust; the frame goes almost black and grey for a moment.
SHOT 14 (00:07.8-00:08.3) — Landing. Medium wide: she lands beside a marble block and strikes a charging bearded man, dust rolling, beaten men lying in red heaps on the white floor behind.
SHOT 15 (00:08.3-00:08.6) — Elbow. Medium close-up: she snaps a backhand elbow into a bald man's face, his head whipping back, her ponytail streaming.
SHOT 16 (00:08.6-00:09.1) — Bodies flying. Low wide: a man flies sideways through the air at frame left after her kick; she stands in the middle in her trailing black chiffon; a man raises a pickaxe at frame right; more men charge across the background.
SHOT 17 (00:09.1-00:10.0) — Flying knee. Low angle: she springs off a white boulder in the foreground and drives a flying knee into a man holding a pickaxe.
SHOT 18 (00:10.0-00:11.8) — Crane down into the fight. Starts as a high aerial wide looking down at the cracked white quarry floor: she fights in the center, men running at her from every direction, beaten men lying spread-eagled in red; the camera cranes down and pushes in at speed as she throws two men, until it reaches ground level as she delivers a straight high side kick into a man's chest, her leg fully extended. MUST SHOW: the web of dark cracks across the white floor seen from above.
SHOT 19 (00:11.8-00:12.9) — Hero landing and the pillars. Low wide from the front, crawler crane in the back left: she lands in a crouch with one fist and one knee on the marble, a spider-web of cracks bursting outward from her fist; a shockwave of dust rolls out and tall rectangular white marble pillars erupt upward out of the floor all around her while the red-suited men are hurled into the air. MUST SHOW: the tall white marble pillars bursting up from the ground in clouds of dust, and the crack web spreading from her fist.
SHOT 20 (00:12.9-00:15.1) — The finale. High aerial drone wide over a forest of tall white marble pillars standing across the quarry floor, the crane at the back left: the last men fly outward and drop flat onto the white floor around her; the drone glides forward and slowly descends toward the center as she rises from her crouch and stands tall and still, ponytail and chiffon moving in the wind, beaten men lying spread-eagled in a ring around her on the cracked marble. MUST SHOW: the ring of fallen red-suited men around her among the white pillars.

SOUND: no dialogue, no voices except grunts. An epic orchestral action score with heavy taiko-style percussion and deep cinematic booms under the whole piece. Heavy running footsteps on stone, sharp punch and kick impacts, cloth whooshes, ponytail swishes, grunts, bodies thudding onto marble, pickaxes and hammers clanging on stone, dust bursts. SHOT 13: a muffled whoosh. SHOT 19: a huge bass impact on the landing, cracking stone and the rumble of pillars rising. SHOT 20: wind, settling dust and a final low drum hit as she stands.
prompt_short: Photoreal martial arts film in a white marble quarry: a black-clad woman with a high braided ponytail fights dozens of men in red coveralls, flying kicks and sweeps, then a hero landing makes marble pillars erupt as the men fall around her. Aerial finale.
